name: 'Til Death Do Us Part (Temporarily)
source:
You're going out on a date with your beautiful goth necromantress girlfriend, whom you like very much, and are entirely devoted to. And who, unfortunately, accidentally kills you. A lot.

Her hugs break your bones, her kisses stop your heart, minute disagreements over dinner cause you to be pulled under by the hordes of the undead.

Luckily, resurrection is easy!

[Edited from [url=https://manioora.itch.io/tddup]itch.io[/url]]
